text: Press Release•August 20, 2026National Baptist Convention Endorses Cindy Holscher and KC Ohaebosim for Governor and Lieutenant GovernorToday, the Holscher-Ohaebosim campaign announced the endorsement of the nation's largest Black religious organization, the National Baptist Convention, USA. The organization represents roughly 7.5 million members across 30,000 congregations.

Press Release•August 27, 2026First Poll of General Election Shows Holscher Leading Masterson in Kansas Governor RaceToday, Global Strategy Group released a new poll of likely Kansas voters showing that Democrat Cindy Holscher is leading Republican Ty Masterson in the gubernatorial election. The poll is the first to be publicly released since both candidates became their respective parties’ nominees on August 4.
